narrative_purpose: Gives the three Holling functional-response shapes a memorable visual: three distinct glowing curves rising from a shared origin so the reader can feel the difference between linear, saturating, and S-shaped responses.
subject: Three distinct glowing trajectories ascending from a single shared origin point at the lower left of a deep indigo field. One trajectory climbs as a straight diagonal before leveling to a horizontal plateau. A second trajectory climbs steeply at first then bends smoothly toward the same upper ceiling. A third trajectory hugs low and flat near the origin, sweeps upward in a smooth S-curve, and levels off at the ceiling. The three paths glow in distinct living teal, ember amber, and bioluminescent magenta.
scene: An abstract naturalist field plate illustrating the three curves of predator intake against deep indigo space.
camera: Flat head-on naturalist cutaway view of the plot.
light: Self-luminous curves and axis lines against dark; no external light.
palette: Void-indigo ground, the three curves in living-teal, ember-amber, and Pandora-cyan respectively, axis lines pale stone-grey.
style: Painterly plate that reads as a plot through composition alone, soft glowing curve-lines, not a hard vector chart.
detail_level: Moderate: three curve shapes clearly distinct (straight-then-flat, bend-over, S-shape), origin shared, ceiling shared.
composition: Three glowing curves rising from lower left across the frame, framed by generous deep indigo negative space.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette with the three curve tones matching the interactive figure's tones (teal Type I, amber Type II, cyan Type III). Reads as a teaching plot.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no tick marks, no arrows, no grid, no diagram chrome, no photographic or 3D-render look
